stops.x: Thai AirAsia FD147, the direct flight to Bangkok Don Mueang (flies Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun). Book all four seats on one booking and fill in the TDAC arrival card before check-in.
Land at Don Mueang. Visa-free entry for 30 days. Grab XL into the old city and find an early breakfast.
Be at the gate when it opens; it gets crowded by 10:00. Shoulders and knees covered.
The 46 m reclining Buddha, a short walk south.
Cross the river by the small ferry. Then lunch and a few hours' sleep: book a day room or a cheap hotel night so you can shower before the bus.
Grab XL to the terminal, then a VIP 24-seat sleeper bus to Krabi in the evening. Bring jackets: the AC runs cold.
Arrive early morning and take a taxi to Ao Nang, about 30 minutes.
Drop bags, breakfast, sleep off two nights of travel.
Longtail from Ao Nang beach. Walk over to Phra Nang Cave beach, then back to Railay West for sunset.
Charter a private longtail for the four of you: Poda, Chicken Island, the Tup sandbar and Phra Nang.
Christmas Eve on the Ao Nang beachfront.

days.h: Across the bay to Koh Yao Noi

stops.x: Green Planet speedboat leaves at 09:20.
Rent two scooters and ride the coast road. Sunset at Pasai or Tha Khao.

days.h: Phang Nga Bay from the island

stops.x: Longtail to the Hong islands lagoon, ringed by limestone cliffs; mangrove kayaking on the way back.
Optional stop at the Laem Had sandbar on Koh Yao Yai.
Seafood dinner by the water. This is a Muslim island: cover up in the villages.
Speedboat from Koh Yao Noi to Phuket.
Swim and lunch at Phuket's quieter south end.
Lard Yai Sunday Walking Street market on Thalang Road. It only runs on Sundays.
Soi Romanee, a dim sum breakfast, then the view over Phuket Town from Khao Rang.
Akasa QP624 departs 17:05.
Land at Kempegowda International Airport.
Thai AirAsia FD147, the direct flight to Bangkok Don Mueang (flies Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun). Book all four seats on one booking and fill in the TDAC arrival card before check-in.

days.h: Bangkok to Phuket, easy first day

stops.x: Land at Don Mueang, clear immigration, and check in for the domestic hop. Pick an 08:00–10:00 Phuket flight to leave a buffer if FD147 runs late.
Land in Phuket. Pre-book a van for four with bags.
Check in, sleep, then an afternoon walk: Thalang Road, Soi Romanee, a dim sum or mee hokkien lunch.
Sunset at Phuket's southern tip.

days.h: Samet Nangshe and Phang Nga Bay

stops.x: Sunrise straight over the karsts of Phang Nga Bay. Pickup around 05:00.
Longtail through the bay to James Bond Island, then canoe through Talu Island's lagoons.
Lunch at the floating Muslim fishing village.
Back by late afternoon. Dinner in the Old Town.
Private car for the four of you, 2.5–3 hours.
Longtail to Railay, Phra Nang Cave beach, then sunset at Railay West. Christmas Eve back in Ao Nang.
Private longtail to Poda, Chicken Island, the Tup sandbar and Phra Nang. Or the Hong lagoon by speedboat.
Christmas dinner in Ao Nang.

days.h: Tiger Cave, then Koh Yao Noi

stops.x: Optional dawn climb: 1,200+ steps to the summit shrine before the heat.
Supaporn boat from Railay East leaves at 13:00. Skip the climb and you can take the 09:20 Green Planet boat from Nopparat Thara instead.
Rent two scooters and ride the coast road. Sunset at Pasai or Tha Khao.

days.h: Phang Nga Bay from the island

stops.x: Longtail to the Hong islands lagoon; mangrove kayaking on the way back.
Optional stop at the Laem Had sandbar on Koh Yao Yai.
Seafood dinner by the water. Cover up in the villages.
Morning speedboat to Phuket. Don't leave it to the afternoon: the last boats run around 17:00.
Lunch on the way; Akasa QP624 departs 17:05.
Land at Kempegowda International Airport.

lko.x: Nawabi-era complex with the Bhool Bhulaiya maze. Worth an evening visit before the late flight.
The 18th-century gateway next to the Imambara, lit up after dark.

dmk.x: Bangkok's best-kept fresh market; good fruit and breakfast stalls from early morning.

palace.x: The royal field north of the palace; open space with a view of the spires.
Hands-on museum about Thai identity, a short walk south.
Backpacker street 1 km north; busy, cheap food, best after dark.

watpho.x: Riverside pier and old shophouses where the ferry to Wat Arun leaves.
24-hour flower market, mountains of marigolds and orchids.

watarun.x: Street food capital of Bangkok; a short taxi or boat ride east.
Old riverside quarter of mechanics' shops, street art and cafés.

krabibus.x: Twin limestone peaks rising from the river at Krabi Town; longtail ride from the pier.
Waterfront walk with the crab statues and mangrove views.

aonang.x: Long, quieter beach just west; at low tide you can walk to the islets.
Short jungle path over the headland to a small private-feeling beach.
75-million-year-old fossil shell slabs; 20 min by car.

railay.x: Arguably Krabi's prettiest beach, 10 minutes' walk; the princess shrine cave is at the end.
Steep, muddy scramble with ropes to a view over both bays. Shoes, not flip-flops.
Climbers' beach next door, reachable at low tide or over the rocks.
Boardwalk cave with glittering rock formations, near Railay East.

railayE.x: Steep, muddy scramble with ropes to a view over both bays.
Boardwalk cave with glittering rock formations.
Walk over for a swim while you wait for the boat.

poda.x: The rock shaped like a chicken's head; snorkelling stop on the 4-island loop.
At low tide a sandbar joins Koh Tup and Koh Mor; walk between them.

nopparat.x: Long casuarina-lined beach next to the pier; quieter than Ao Nang.

kyn.x: The island's main beach strip; cafés and the best sunset bars.
Fishing village and pier on the north-east; views to the Hong islands.
Paddle the mangrove channels on the west coast with a local guide.

hong.x: Short climb on Koh Hong for a view over the lagoon and bay (park fee applies).

kyy.x: Rubber plantations and quiet Muslim villages; best seen by scooter.

bangrong.x: Jungle walk to a small waterfall in Khao Phra Thaeo park, 10 minutes by car.

naiharn.x: Tiny cove with good snorkelling just south of Nai Harn.
Hilltop with the big wind turbine and a view down to Nai Harn bay.
Phuket's famous sunset point, 5 minutes south.

promthep.x: Tiny cove for a swim before sunset.
Less crowded sunset spot just north.

oldtown.x: The prettiest lane of painted Sino-Portuguese shophouses.
Hidden 1890s Chinese shrine off Phang Nga Road.
oldtown.q: Shrine of the Serene Light Phuket

oldtown.x: Hill above town with a view over Phuket City and the bay.

khaorang.x: The prettiest lane of painted Sino-Portuguese shophouses.
Hidden 1890s Chinese shrine off Phang Nga Road.
khaorang.q: Shrine of the Serene Light Phuket

hkt.x: Planes land low over this beach at the end of the runway.
Calm, shady beach 10 minutes from the terminal; a good last swim.

samet.x: Glass-floored walkway above the jungle next to the viewpoint.

jbond.x: Canoe under the cliffs into hidden hongs (enclosed lagoons).

panyee.x: The village's famous floating pitch, built by local kids in the 1980s.

tiger.x: Twin limestone peaks by the river at Krabi Town.

stays.On the flight: Thai AirAsia FD147, overnight in your seats. Bring neck pillows.
stays.Overnight VIP bus to Krabi: VIP 24-seat sleeper, ~12 h. Rent a Bangkok day room for the afternoon so you can sleep and shower first.
stays.Ao Nang, Krabi: Two doubles or a family room near the beach, ~$35–117 per room per night in December. Book now with free cancellation.
stays.Koh Yao Noi: Beach bungalows ~$35–60 per night, or a 2-bedroom villa for four. Pasai beach area is easiest.
stays.Phuket Old Town: Boutique shophouse hotels on Thalang / Dibuk Rd; budget rooms reach $70–90 over Christmas.
